_note: Task registry. Every task needs: task_id, owner, description, files, status, dependencies, expected_output. Never start a task assigned to the other agent. Valid statuses: PLANNED, READY, IN_PROGRESS, BLOCKED, REVIEW, COMPLETED, ABANDONED.

tasks.description: Bootstrap collaboration scaffolding (AGENTS.md, .ai/ registries, docs/, tests/, git init, agent worktree)
tasks.expected_output: Protocol-mandated structure present in repo; ready for Agent A integration review
tasks.notes: Documentation-only task; no runtime code, so no test/build applicable.

tasks.description: Define architecture ADRs and finalize ownership for agent platform
tasks.expected_output: ADR-003 through ADR-012 documented; ownership.json finalized with real architecture globs
tasks.notes: Architecture: modular, model-agnostic agent platform with 10 core modules

tasks.description: Set up project infrastructure: package.json, tsconfig, ESLint, Vitest, directory structure
tasks.expected_output: Project builds (tsc), lints (eslint), tests run (vitest). All dirs exist with index.ts barrels.
tasks.notes: TypeScript strict mode, ESM, path aliases (@core, @providers, @tools, @git, @comm, @memory, @tasks, @safety, @obs, @agents, @types, @app)

tasks.description: Implement core types and interfaces: Agent, Task, Tool, Message, Memory, Provider, Permission
tasks.expected_output: All core types defined with Zod schemas for runtime validation. Exported from @types.
tasks.notes: Shared with Agent B via shared ownership of src/agents/interfaces/**

tasks.description: Implement LLM Provider Abstraction: ModelProvider interface, OpenAI/Anthropic/Azure implementations, factory
tasks.expected_output: Provider interface with chat(), stream(), embed(), countTokens(). 4+ implementations. Config-driven factory.
tasks.notes: Model-agnostic per ADR-005. Agent B's specialist agent will use this abstraction.

tasks.description: Implement Tool System: Tool interface, Registry, TerminalTool, FilesystemTool, GitTool, WebSearchTool
tasks.expected_output: Typed tools with Zod schemas, timeouts, permissions, structured results. Registry for discovery.
tasks.notes: Per ADR-006. Tools declare permissions for safety system.

tasks.description: Implement Git Worktree Management: WorktreeManager, BranchManager, MergeCoordinator
tasks.expected_output: Create/sync/remove worktrees. Branch lifecycle. Merge proposal with diff review. CLI commands.
tasks.notes: Per ADR-007. Enables agent isolation protocol.

tasks.description: Implement Inter-Agent Communication: MessageBus, message types, file persistence, subscriptions
tasks.expected_output: Typed messages (TaskAssign, StatusUpdate, ReviewRequest, ContextHandoff, Escalation). File-based persistence to .ai/communication/. Pub/sub.
tasks.notes: Per ADR-008. Agent B will use this for specialist agent coordination.

tasks.description: Implement Task Ownership & Coordination: OwnershipRegistry, TaskRegistry, FileLockManager
tasks.expected_output: Reads .ai/ownership.json, .ai/active-tasks.json, .ai/locks/. CLI: claim-task, release-task, check-ownership, list-tasks.
tasks.notes: Per ADR-009. Enforces protocol ownership rules.

tasks.description: Implement Agent Runtime Base: BaseAgent, AgentContext, execution loop, error handling, lifecycle
tasks.expected_output: Abstract BaseAgent with: plan(), act(), reflect(), learn(). Context injection. Tool calling. Error recovery. Lifecycle hooks.
tasks.notes: Shared interface (src/agents/interfaces/). Agent B implements SpecialistAgent extending BaseAgent.

tasks.description: Implement Lead Architect Agent: planning, decomposition, code review, integration decisions
tasks.expected_output: LeadAgent extends BaseAgent. Capabilities: task planning, subtask decomposition, code review, merge decisions, architecture guidance.
tasks.notes: Agent A's primary agent. Uses all core systems.

tasks.description: Implement Specialist Implementation Agent: code generation, testing, refactoring, documentation
tasks.expected_output: SpecialistAgent extends BaseAgent. Capabilities: implement specs, write tests, refactor, document. Uses tools, providers, memory.
tasks.notes: BLOCKED: src/agents/base/ does not exist; base-agent.ts (+ agent-context, execution-loop, error-handler, lifecycle) still in src/_excluded/. Expected output requires extends BaseAgent -- will not guess. REQUIRED from agent_a: restore src/agents/base/** or delegate BaseAgent implementation. Verified BUG-001,004-012 NOT actually fixed (code unchanged; see comm).

tasks.description: Implement Project Memory: MemoryStore, CodebaseIndexer, DecisionLog, ContextBuilder
tasks.expected_output: Vector + structured memory. Codebase embeddings for semantic search. Decision log. Context assembly for tasks.

tasks.description: Implement Safety & Permissions: PermissionSet, PermissionChecker, ApprovalGate, AuditLog
tasks.expected_output: Capability-based permissions. Tools declare required perms. Agents scoped. Dangerous ops require approval. Audit trail.
tasks.notes: Per ADR-011. Config files for each agent's permission set.

tasks.description: Implement Observability: Logger, Metrics, Tracer, HealthCheck
tasks.expected_output: Structured logging (pino). Prometheus metrics. OpenTelemetry traces. Health endpoints. Integrated across all systems.
tasks.notes: Per ADR-012. Essential for debugging autonomous agents.

tasks.description: Implement Core Application Entry: CLI, agent orchestration, config loading, graceful shutdown
tasks.expected_output: CLI: start-agent, run-task, review-merge, sync-memory. Orchestrator manages agent lifecycle. Config from env/files.
tasks.notes: Main entry point. Integrates all modules.

tasks.description: Write unit tests for core types, providers, tools, git, comm, tasks, memory, safety, obs
tasks.expected_output: Unit tests for all Agent A modules. Vitest. Coverage >80%. Run via 'npm test'.
tasks.notes: Agent B owns tests/ per ownership.json. 368 tests passing.

tasks.description: Write integration tests: agent orchestration, tool execution, git workflow, inter-agent communication
tasks.expected_output: Integration tests covering full agent workflows. Run via 'npm test:integration'.
tasks.notes: Partially blocked: agent-orchestration/git-workflow/end-to-end tests need src/app/** and src/git/** (still _excluded/). tool-execution + inter-agent-comm portions startable. Deps (TASK-016, TASK-017) are COMPLETED.

tasks.description: Documentation: architecture guide, API reference, agent development guide, deployment guide
tasks.expected_output: Complete docs for platform users and agent developers. Examples in docs/examples/.
tasks.notes: Deliverables written and verified: 4 guides + 4 runnable examples; typecheck/tests/examples all green; report filed in communication.
